Protests Demand CEC Resignation, CJP Launches Campaign

The Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) is organizing nationwide protests starting October 2, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. The protests are part of a campaign titled 'Fix the Election Commission'. Two programs involving the CEC have been postponed. The Congress party is also planning nationwide demonstrations.
